reforms.description: The Canadian government introduced a new system of outright grants to replace the previous tax concessions for scientific research expenditures, which were aimed at increasing research outlays by firms.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The new grant system is expected to incentivize higher research spending by firms, thereby enhancing innovation and productivity.
reforms.status_evidence: The tax concessions were replaced by a system of outright grants.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant shift in funding mechanisms for research, likely leading to increased investment in R&D by the private sector.
reforms.source_quote: The tax concessions previously in force regarding expenditures on scientific research... are to be replaced by a system of outright grants.
